recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Further source work is not needed for FHIR-48727 unless OO later decides to change consumedItem cardinality or add additional narrative guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-48727 was an Applied R6 OO change request asking whether NutritionIntake.nutritionItem could safely have multiple consumedItem instances when the model also had a notConsumed boolean and reason. The final Persuasive with Modification resolution was to pull the not-consumed flag and reason into a backbone element and add schedule and amount.
initial_application: No current source-history commit explicitly names FHIR-48727. The relevant NutritionIntake model change appears to have been applied in commit 05e646d74bb93a1c435d884747dc64da94898435, which removed the old notConsumed boolean/notConsumedReason shape and added NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.notConsumedItem with reason, schedule, and amount. Commit 9a769f27d3fdb6cee91898dd5d75c079b77a0563 then updated examples to the reorganized NutritionIntake model.
additional_context: FHIR-45063 had already required separating consumed and not-consumed NutritionIntake items, and FHIR-47247 considered whether the old notConsumed flag needed modifier treatment. The January 15, 2025 OO Nutrition minutes record FHIR-48727's decision to pull the not-consumed flag and reason into a backbone element adding schedule and amount. NutritionIntake is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to OO.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/nutritionintake/structuredefinition-NutritionIntake.xml defines NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.consumedItem as a 0..* BackboneElement for consumed items and separately defines NutritionIntake.nutritionItem.notConsumedItem as a 0..* BackboneElement with reason, schedule, and amount, which satisfies the approved FHIR-48727 model without changing consumedItem cardinality.
